body: DONE + BUILD SUCCEEDED (xcodebuild generic/platform=iOS, Debug): (1) typing expiry — ChatEngine gained peerTypingSeenAtMsByChatId/peerTypingExpiryMs(6500)/expirePeerTypingLocked/schedulePeerTypingExpiryLocked, the typing frame branch stamps and schedules, sendTypingState re-pushes a live typing after typingRefreshMs(3500), and ChatListView.inputBarTextDidChange arms a 5s idle stop-typing (typingIdleStopWorkItem). (2) reaction/meta overlap — measureMessageBubbleLayout reserves reactionSize.width + bubbleMetaInlineSpacing + meta.total via reactionRowWidth, reactionBadgeFrame takes trailingReserve, ChatListCell.layoutSubviews centres the meta on the strip row and passes the reserve. (3) height invalidation — chatListRowSignatureFields appends ('reactions', emoji x count) LAST, bubbleLayoutRevision bumped to r9-reaction-row-meta. (4) chip tap toggles the reaction off (ChatReactionChipView.onTap -> strip.onTap -> cell.onReactionTap -> ChatListView.toggleReactionFromChip) plus a 1.2s alpha reveal fallback so a dropped flight cannot leave a chip invisible. STILL OPEN: cross-device live reaction refresh, and the RTL send-morph shift.
